nodes.name: Commit Pipeline (Pensieve)
nodes.summary: Pensieve pipeline that runs on git commit. Auto-detects whether the commit contains reusable insights (debugging findings, architectural decisions, patterns, anti-patterns, ownership/boundary clarifications), extracts and classifies them (IS->knowledge, WANT->decision, MUST->maxim), writes them per spec, refreshes project state, and then performs atomic commits grouped by reason for change. Auto-gated, no user confirmation.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with YAML frontmatter (type: pipeline, status: active, stages, gate: auto). Frontmatter declares id, type, title, status, created/updated, tags, name, description, stages, gate. Body uses H1 title, H2 sections (Signal Judgment Rules, Task Blueprint, Failure Fallback) and H3 per-task blocks with Goal / Read inputs / Steps / Completion criteria sub-fields. Wikilink context-links point to knowledge/taste-review/content.

nodes.name: Code Review Pipeline (Pensieve)
nodes.summary: Pensieve pipeline for code review. Performs baseline exploration (commit history + hotspots) to scope review, prepares review context, runs a per-file evidence-recorded review, verifies candidates and filters out confidence <80 issues, generates an actionable report with severity tiers, and optionally captures reusable conclusions to decision/knowledge. Only high-signal, reproducible, locatable issues are reported; review standards live in the referenced knowledge/taste-review file to avoid duplication.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with YAML frontmatter (type: pipeline, status: active, stages: [tasks], gate: auto). H1 title, H2 sections (Signal Judgment Rules, Task Blueprint, Failure Fallback), six H3 tasks each with Goal / Read inputs / Steps / Completion criteria. Explicitly defers standards and rationale to knowledge/taste-review/content.md. Lists explicit failure-mode handling for missing git history, unclear scope, unverifiable issues, and all-filtered-out.

nodes.name: Sync to Main Pipeline (Pensieve)
nodes.summary: Pensieve pipeline for syncing changes from experimental/zh branches to the English-only main branch while preserving contributor commit history. Steps: confirm scope via git diff stat, branch from main and merge with -X theirs, translate residual Chinese content to English (preserving code/paths/bilingual regex), commit with Co-authored-by annotations for external contributors, push, open PR via gh, merge, and clean up the temporary sync branch. Manually gated, project-specific to Pensieve language policy.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with YAML frontmatter (type: pipeline, status: active, gate: manual). H1 title, four H2 tasks (Confirm Scope, Create Branch and Merge, Translation, PR and Merge) plus Failure Fallback. References remote name 'kingkongshot' and repo 'kingkongshot/Pensieve' in concrete shell commands; defines CJK grep regex [一-龥] for residual-Chinese verification. No Based on/Leads to wikilinks.
